q: A roundabout makes one revolution in $6.0\,\text{s}$. How large is the speed of a child sitting $2.4\,\text{m}$ from the centre?
a: $v = \dfrac{2\pi r}{T} = \dfrac{2\pi \cdot 2.4\,\text{m}}{6.0\,\text{s}} \approx 2.5\,\text{m/s}$. The velocity is along the tangent of the path, and a child sitting next to the central pole moves more slowly, although the period is the same.

q: A satellite is moved from an orbit of radius $r$ to an orbit of radius $3r$. By what factor does the gravitational force of the Earth on the satellite change?
a: The gravitational force is inversely proportional to the square of the distance: $\dfrac{F_2}{F_1} = \dfrac{r^2}{(3r)^2} = \dfrac{1}{9}$. The force falls to a ninth, but it does not vanish.
